chrome.1: Click the icon to the left of the address bar.

edge.1: Click the lock icon to the left of the address bar.
edge.2: Open Permissions for this site and set Microphone to Allow.

safari.1: Open the Safari menu, then Settings for this website.

iphone.1: Open the Settings app, then Apps, then Safari.
iphone.2: Under Settings for Websites, tap Microphone and choose Allow.
iphone.3: Come back and reload the page.
